## Oppositions

| Axis                      | Stances                                                                | Contended resource                                               | Recorded sacrifice                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| ------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `proof-vs-cost`           | luwu-proof-at-write-stance vs luwu-bounded-cost-stance                 | latency and throughput of one apply over a whole profile         | Cost won twice: per-action expansion is scoped, and later actions no longer compare rendered desired bytes after the first directory creation. Proof won on mtime-only checks, parallel writers, and counting durability inside the budget.                                       |
| `exposure-vs-continuity`  | luwu-minimal-exposure-stance vs luwu-continuable-evidence-stance       | user-visible surface and correctness of the operator's next step | Exposure won: no undeclared-value record, no secret digest, no provider cache. Evidence won where it costs no value: plan evidence, replacement flags, skip reason codes, and committed-but-baseline-not-advanced.                                                                |
| `authority-vs-completion` | luwu-answerable-authority-stance vs luwu-operational-completion-stance | operator attention and migration cost of moving a real profile   | Completion won inside one resource: apply writes a forward field while a sibling field needs review. Authority won on the generic rule: no force or precedence flag, no whole-file reverse copy, no automatic Dotter conversion.                                                  |
| `footprint-vs-recovery`   | luwu-minimal-footprint-stance vs luwu-continuable-evidence-stance      | reversibility and durability of what a failed run leaves behind  | Footprint won: no transaction engine, journal, durable plan, replay, or rollback; a fresh plan is the recovery step. A SIGKILL between naming and renaming can leave a private temporary file that nothing sweeps.                                                                |
| `equivalence-vs-noise`    | luwu-proven-equivalence-stance vs luwu-quiet-signal-stance             | correctness and the operator attention a false difference costs  | Equivalence won: no generic formatter or schema registry, a lexical TOML patcher with byte-level negative controls, re-render proof before an undeclared write. Quiet won where evidence exists: structured semantic equality and a baseline-only write for a converged template. |
